biometric_invalidated: Your device's screen lock changed, so the app can't be unlocked here any more. Reinstall and restore each wallet from its recovery phrase.
bitbox_connect_body: Connect your BitBox02 over USB. It only ever signs — this app never sees its recovery words. Bitcoin (BTC) only; the device can't sign for the XBT fork.
bitbox_pairing_body: Confirm this code matches what's shown on your BitBox02, then confirm there.
create_passphrase_hint: A "25th word" — an extra secret, not stored. If you set one you need both the phrase and this to restore. Leave blank if unsure.
create_phrase_body: Write these %1$d words on paper, offline. Anyone with them controls your funds.
dialog_remove_body: This only removes the wallet from this app. Nothing on the blockchain changes, and you can add it back any time with its recovery phrase (and passphrase, if you set one). Make sure the phrase is written down.
dialog_reveal_body: The recovery phrase (and passphrase, if you set one) is the only thing that can restore this wallet — and anyone who has it can spend your funds. Only reveal it somewhere private, with no one watching. The next screen blocks screenshots.
dialog_reveal_body_web: The recovery phrase (and passphrase, if you set one) is the only thing that can restore this wallet — and anyone who has it can spend your funds. Only reveal it somewhere private, with no one watching.
error_bitbox_not_found: Couldn't find your BitBox02. Check it's plugged in and unlocked, and that no other app has it open.
error_bitbox_xbt_unsupported: BitBox02 hardware wallets can only sign for Bitcoin (BTC) — the XBT fork uses a signature scheme no hardware wallet supports.
error_confirm_phrase: First confirm you've written the recovery phrase down.
error_enter_xpub: Enter an extended public key (xpub) first.
error_invalid_fingerprint: that doesn't look like a fingerprint — it should be 8 hex characters, e.g. a1b2c3d4
error_invalid_xpub: that extended public key (xpub) is not valid
error_no_fingerprint_on_file: This watch-only wallet has no master fingerprint on file, so it can't export a transaction for offline signing — remove and re-add it with the fingerprint from the signing wallet's Settings ("Copy fingerprint").
error_wallet_max: You can keep up to %1$d wallets on one device.
error_wallet_name_too_long: wallet name must be under %1$d characters
error_xpub_is_master_key: That's a master key (depth 0), not an account xpub — export your wallet's account-level xpub instead (its own "Copy xpub"/watch-only export).
export_psbt_body: Scan this on the offline device, or copy the text below — either way it carries no key material, only the transaction to sign.
export_psbt_too_large_for_qr: Too large for one QR code — copy the text below instead.
field_encryption_password: Encryption password (protects the seed on this device)
field_master_fingerprint: Master fingerprint (optional — needed to export for offline signing)
gen_body: Your phone already generated a secure seed. Shake it — or scribble on the pad — to stir in extra entropy from the motion sensors and timing jitter. Belt and braces.
gen_body_web: Your device already generated a secure seed. Drag your pointer around to stir in extra entropy from your own motion and your machine’s timing jitter — belt and braces.
gen_entropy_full: plenty of extra entropy — the base seed is already secure
gen_words_hint: Both are secure; 12 is easier to write down.
history_hint: tap a transaction to open it in the explorer · long-press to copy the id
history_hint_web: tap a transaction to open it in the explorer
import_signed_body: Paste the transaction text the offline device produced. Broadcasting sends it to the network — this can't be undone.
lock_choice_biometric_note: One unlock opens all your wallets. No password to remember — your device's fingerprint/face or screen-lock PIN gets you in.
lock_choice_password_note: This password unlocks the app and every wallet in it.
lock_choice_prf_note: Uses this device’s fingerprint, face, or screen lock via the browser. Your app password always still works as a fallback.
lock_choice_use_biometric: Lock the app with fingerprint or PIN
lock_choice_use_prf: Enable quick unlock with this device
lock_password_hint: Choose a password of at least %1$d characters to continue.
offline_advisory_note: For this to actually be air-gapped, disconnect this device from the network before pasting the unsigned transaction below.
onboard_tagline: a non-custodial wallet for Bitcoin XBT and Bitcoin BTC
prf_invalidated: Quick unlock stopped working for this device — its saved credential may have been removed or changed. Use your app password instead.
prf_not_supported: Quick unlock isn’t supported by this browser.
prf_status_on: Quick unlock is on for this device.
psbt_paste_body: Paste the unsigned transaction text from the watch-only wallet.
receive_qr_hint: long-press or double-tap the QR to copy it as an image
restore_body: Enter your 12 or 24 words, separated by spaces.
restore_clone_hint: After it's added you can also list this wallet on %1$s from Manage wallets — same phrase, same addresses.
reveal_no_passphrase: No BIP-39 passphrase on this wallet.
reveal_warning: Anyone who sees these words — plus the passphrase, if set — can spend this wallet. Only look at them somewhere private. Never type them into a website or app. Screenshots are blocked here.
reveal_warning_web: Anyone who sees these words — plus the passphrase, if set — can spend this wallet. Only look at them somewhere private. Never type them into a website or app. Unlike the mobile app, a browser can't block screenshots — be extra careful about who can see your screen.
send_fee_from_amount: Take the fees out of this amount
send_fee_from_amount_note: The recipient receives the amount minus the network and service fees, instead of the fees being added on top.
send_replay_note: Adds ~110 vB of fee. An oversized OP_RETURN — Bitcoin Core 30+ relays it, older nodes and Knots may not. If the broadcast is rejected the transaction is still valid; resend it through a node that relays large OP_RETURN.
send_service_fee: Service fee: %1$s%% of the amount sent (min %2$d sat) — supports this hosted node.
settings_degraded_note: The fortis service is unreachable — using public block data for now. It'll switch back automatically.
settings_key_software: This device has no secure hardware — the unlock key is protected in software only.
signed_export_body: Scan this on the online device, or copy the text below, to broadcast it.
settings_one_unlock: One unlock opens every wallet in the app.
settings_verify_body: This page is plain static source with no build step — everything it loads except the signing engine's compiled binary is exactly the code in the public repository. build-info.json lists a SHA-256 hash of every file this page loaded and the commit it was built from, so you (or anyone) can check the live site matches that source before trusting it with real funds.
settings_verify_unavailable: Not available for this build (a local checkout, or one published before this existed).
settings_dedicated_profile: For meaningful amounts, use a browser profile with no extensions installed, dedicated to this wallet — a malicious extension can read anything on the page, and no website can prevent that. The Android app has a smaller attack surface if you need to hold more.
watch_body: Paste an account-level extended public key (xpub). It can only ever see this wallet's addresses, balance, and history — it can never spend from it.
wipe_confirm: Erase the encrypted seed from this device? Restore needs your recovery phrase.
